description_expanded: AboutWise Choice on 30A | Luxury Eastern Lake Vacation Rental South of 30A | Kayak to the Beach | Waterfront Townhome Why Guests Love Wise Choice on 30A • Luxury 30A vacation rental located directly on Eastern Lake, a rare coastal dune lake • South of 30A location near the beach with easy kayak access to the Gulf • Two complimentary kayaks for paddling from the lake to the beach • Private dock with seating for fishing, relaxing, and enjoying peaceful water views • Add a street legal golf cart and receive a 10% discount off the golf cart rental rate • Two king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms for privacy and comfort • Bonus sunroom with two twin beds overlooking the canal • Fully remodeled coastal townhome with all new furniture and luxury décor • Screened-in porch with outdoor seating overlooking Eastern Lake • Two bikes for exploring Scenic Highway 30A and nearby beach towns • Four backpack beach chairs and one beach umbrella included • Games, books, and fishing poles for indoor and outdoor fun • Fully stocked kitchen with modern appliances, cookware, and essentials • Wet bar for entertaining and relaxing evenings • High-speed internet and smart TVs throughout • Full-size washer and dryer • Starter amenities including Starbucks coffee, bottled water, and bathroom essentials • Two designated parking spaces • Close to Seaside, Alys Beach, The Hub, Old Florida Fish House, dining, shopping, and entertainment A Luxury 30A Vacation Rental on Eastern Lake Welcome to Wise Choice on 30A, a beautifully remodeled luxury townhome located directly on Eastern Lake, one of the most sought-after coastal dune lakes along Scenic Highway 30A. Perfectly positioned south of 30A and close to the beach, this waterfront retreat offers a peaceful setting with easy access to the Gulf, boutique shopping, dining, and iconic beach towns. Whether you are searching for a 30A vacation rental, an Eastern Lake waterfront rental, or a luxury townhome near Seaside and Alys Beach, Wise Choice on 30A delivers a rare combination of tranquility, location, and upscale comfort. Thoughtfully Designed Coastal Living Step inside and immediately feel at ease in this 100 percent remodeled 30A townhome, thoughtfully furnished with coastal luxury décor and modern finishes. The open-concept living space is bright, welcoming, and designed for relaxing after beach days or lake adventures. The living area flows seamlessly into a screened-in porch overlooking Eastern Lake, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or sunset cocktails with calming water views. Fully Equipped Kitchen and Entertaining Spaces The fully stocked kitchen is ideal for preparing meals at home and includes: • Stainless steel appliances • Quality cookware and utensils • Serveware and glassware • Coffee maker stocked with Starbucks coffee • Wet bar for entertaining A starter supply of kitchen and bathroom amenities, along with bottled water, ensures a smooth and comfortable arrival. Private Suites and Flexible Sleeping This luxury 30A vacation rental comfortably sleeps up to six guests and offers privacy for couples and families alike. Bedroom layout includes: • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom and attached sunroom • Sunroom with two twin beds overlooking the canal Each space is designed to feel like a private retreat, with comfortable bedding, thoughtful touches, and peaceful water views. Waterfront Outdoor Living and Kayak-to-Beach Access One of the most unique features of Wise Choice on 30A is the private dock on Eastern Lake, offering direct access to one of 30A’s most scenic natural environments. Enjoy: • Fishing or relaxing from your private dock • Kayaking across Eastern Lake and out to the Gulf • Watching wildlife and enjoying peaceful lake views • Using provided beach chairs and umbrella for nearby beach days With two complimentary kayaks, paddling from lake to beach becomes part of the adventure and sets this home apart from traditional 30A rentals. Prime 30A Location Near Everything Located on the south side of 30A, Wise Choice on 30A places you close to some of the area’s most popular destinations: • Seaside • Alys Beach • The Hub • Old Florida Fish House • Boutique shopping and local dining • Live music and family-friendly entertainment Bike, drive, or kayak your way to unforgettable 30A experiences. Ideal for Couples, Families, and Relaxing Getaways Wise Choice on 30A is perfect for: • Couples seeking a peaceful waterfront escape • Small families looking for a unique 30A experience • Friends traveling together who want privacy and convenience • Guests wanting luxury without crowds With its waterfront setting, kayak access, luxury interiors, and unbeatable location, this home is a standout among 30A vacation rentals on Eastern Lake. Your Wise Choice on 30A Awaits From lakefront mornings to beach-filled afternoons and relaxing evenings on the screened porch, Wise Choice on 30A offers a truly special coastal escape. If you are searching for a luxury 30A vacation rental, an Eastern Lake waterfront townhome, or a peaceful beach retreat near Seaside and Alys Beach, this home is the perfect choice. Book your stay at Wise Choice on 30A today and experience one of the most unique and relaxing vacation rentals on Scenic Highway 30A.
